== Editing ==
Shared English Decipher-era comparison for [[Sandcrawler: Loading Bay]]. The 1998 Glossary replacement is distinct from the later PC text or uniqueness change. Only source-backed state columns belong here; Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual articles remain in Versions. A blank stamp cell means the cited text document does not establish a printed stamp.
